objective: Validate structural training methods against a strong matched-token NorMuon baseline, separating migration, algorithm, supervision and systems effects.

common.boundary_batches: Use ALL archived rows, including widths 16/32/48 at knots.
common.matrix_decay_policy: External pre-update decay q(t)=1-reference_matrix_peak_lr*0.1*schedule(t), fixed across LR multipliers; native optimizer WD disabled. SF exception: decay on z, documented separately.

base_configuration_snapshot.sweep_purpose: Fixed 2x2 auxiliary AdamW LR x cautious decay; fresh intradoc NS5 NorMuon

calibration.schedule: single-phase token-clock 40% tail, same 4:1:1 shape; SF/constant families instead preserve their constant-LR definition
calibration.scope: numerical and LR-scale screen; short-horizon NLL is not evidence of superiority
calibration.selection: minimum final fixed-1k mean NLL among complete finite trials; ties within .002 choose factor closest to 1; edge optimum flagged as under-calibrated
calibration.v0_evaluation_cadence: For any short model-training check, eval at least every max(1,floor(planned_actual_updates/10)) updates, at endpoint, and every update for very short checks
calibration.aux_lr: fixed at base 1B value except full SF family mapping
calibration.wd: fixed reference shrinkage, not candidate-LR times .1
calibration.target_adjustment: If projected runtime cannot fit before any family trial, pre-register one lower shared target for the whole comparison; never change after observing NLL.

gate_thresholds_proposed.interpretation: engineering gates fixed before measurements; failing exactness does not permit relabeling an approximation as exact

quality_decision.primary_metric: sum document NLL / sum valid prediction tokens
quality_decision.quality_confirmation: paired interval upper < 0; practical delta <= -.005; fresh seed43 same direction; mean across seeds <= -.005
quality_decision.speed_noninferiority: paired interval upper < +.002 and >=5% reduction in actual comparable allocation cost; label efficiency result, not quality improvement
quality_decision.cost_increase_policy: over 5% cost increase is a Pareto tradeoff until compute-matched confirmation
quality_decision.multiple_methods: lock one winner per family before seed43; retain all failed and nonwinning runs
quality_decision.uncertainty: document CI is conditional on trained weights; two seeds do not establish population-level seed confidence

teacher_accounting.conservative_logical_input_charge: student forwards + teacher forwards + any extra model forward on training data
teacher_accounting.schedule_clock: student nonpadding inputs; distinct from conservative logical charge

authorization_scope: Design only. Historical run-specific exceptions do not authorize these new allocations.
implementation_contract: Keep original source-v3 and preparation immutable
Do not emit runnable train configs until method adapters and LR mappings are resolved
Every allocation, including failure and compilation, enters shared ledger
No automatic retry/resume/requeue, HF publication or cleanup

deferred_methods.experiment: fresh N0 versus activation-covariance preconditioned direction; activate only after covariance diagnosis and use same geometry-module cost gates

deferred_methods.requires: new data-mixture protocol; not included in core or given a fabricated cost estimate

deferred_methods.experiment: compare approximate one-gradient implementation with N0; exact variant needs an explicit repeated-input and compute budget
deferred_methods.requires: separate method adapter and resource design
